description: This file defines the data structures, macros, and function prototypes for SID synchronization in an AMR speech codec implementation.

methods.name: sid_sync_init
methods.description: Initializes a sid_syncState instance and returns success status.

methods.name: sid_sync_reset
methods.description: Resets the sid_syncState instance to zero.

methods.name: sid_sync_exit
methods.description: De-initializes the sid_syncState instance and frees resources.

methods.name: sid_sync_set_handover_debt
methods.description: Updates the handover debt in the sid_syncState.

methods.name: sid_sync
methods.description: Performs SID synchronization, ensuring mode only switches to neighboring modes.
